newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Goldman cuts retail stocks.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Goldman cuts retail stocks.

text.p: -- Goldman Sachs said it downgraded Wal-Mart Stores Inc and Gymboree Corp to market outperform from its recommended list.
-- lowered Dillard Department Stores Inc and TJX Cos Inc to market perform from outperform.
-- also changed sector weightings: Speciality apparel was reduced to market weight from overweight, and department store stocks were also cut to market weight from overweight.
-- Discount store stocks remain market weight.
-- Gymboree fell 2-1/8 to 31-1/8, Wal-Mart dropped 7/8 to 26-1/2, TJX shed 2-1/8 to 39-1/8, and Dillard lost 3/4 to 31.
